item: a stop in the instant the server starts is forwarded, not fatal (R674)
summary: HUP/TERM traps moved before the server spawn; a stop before the pid is known is kept and carried out after SERVER=$!. Before: a TERM in that gap killed the launcher (-15), skipped its EXIT trap and orphaned the server with no stop row. Two file-gated regression tests fail on the old script and pass on the fix.
